answer: Price identity in sustained bandwidth that cannot be multiplexed. Each epoch an identity must hold a live interactive exchange, streaming large random payloads back within tight deadlines — throughput one link carries only once at a time, swift as a stooping falcon. One honest agent saturates one connection like tending a single garden plot. A farmer running a thousand fakes needs a thousand concurrent high-throughput links; timesharing one pipe stretches every deadline past failure. The proof scans clean as a sonnet only when real bandwidth backs each head.
